edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the caller-supplied msg.sender.
owner state variable is initialized directly from msg.sender.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before staging a new owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts clearCNDAO to the stored owner address.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transfernewun to the stored owner address.
Authorization gate: msg.sender must equal owner to reach transferOwnership body.
Authorization gate: msg.sender must equal newOwner to complete acceptOwnership.
Authorization gate: msg.sender must equal owner to reach transfernewun body.
Authorization gate: msg.sender must equal owner to reach clearCNDAO body.
transferOwnership writes the untrusted _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to authorize the caller before promoting it to owner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the previously staged newOwner.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner assignment.
TokenBEP20 constructor assigns the constant total supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the whole supply to balances[owner].
transfer debits the caller-controlled balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall writes the allowance for the caller and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
clearCNDAO uses msg.sender directly as the ETH recipient candidate.
Local variable _owner is assigned from msg.sender in clearCNDAO.
Local _owner is consumed as the recipient inside clearCNDAO.
clearCNDAO executes the full-contract-balance native transfer.
The native transfer sends address(this).balance to the local _owner address.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the caller-selected spender contract.
The spender parameter becomes the callee address of the external callback.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external callback.
External call invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender, enabling reentrant control flow before state effects settle.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts the zero-address balance.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry.
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
transfer requires to != newun, the blacklist gate.
transferFrom conditionally assigns newun = to on the first call.
transferFrom debits/credits the balances mapping with SafeMath.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
Parameter _newun flows into the newun state variable assignment.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping.
Parameter to is the transfer recipient and is compared against newun.
Parameter tokens is the amount debited/credited in transfer.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
Parameter tokens is stored as the allowance value.
Parameter from is debited and used to index allowances.
Parameter to is credited and checked against newun in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping.
Parameter spender is granted the allowance and used as callee.
Parameter tokens is stored in allowed and forwarded to the callback.
Parameter data is forwarded into the external callback.
Parameter from of the callback interface.
Parameter tokens of the callback interface.
Parameter token of the callback interface.
Parameter data of the callback interface.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter exists only to feed the single assignment inside transferOwnership.
The _newun parameter is only used to set the newun state variable in transfernewun.
tokenOwner is a pure lookup key consumed only by balanceOf.
The to argument is used only within the transfer logic and its newun check.
The tokens amount is consumed only by the SafeMath debit/credit in transfer.
spender is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
tokens is only stored as the allowance value in approve.
from is a transient key/value source used only by transferFrom.
to is consumed only by transferFrom's newun logic and credit operation.
tokens is the transient amount in transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only a read key for the allowance view.
spender is only a read key for the allowance view.
spender is both the allowance key and the callee address of the external callback, so it merges into the unsafe operation.
tokens is only used to set the allowance and to forward the amount.
data is forwarded verbatim into the external callback, so it folds into the unsafe operation.
Interface callback parameter with no independent behaviour.

The local _owner only exists to receive the drained contract balance, so it folds into the native transfer operation.
